business: Little Shore Play Cafe (a Montessori-inspired play cafe in Salisbury, MD)
target: Parents of children 8 months to 5 years who live in or near Salisbury, MD (Wicomico County, Eastern Shore) and look for indoor places to take their kids
where: Salisbury, MD and surrounding towns (Fruitland, Delmar, Hebron, Princess Anne, Berlin)

behaviours.name: Stay-at-home parent
behaviours.how: Home with the kids on weekdays and always hunting for somewhere to go between naps.

behaviours.name: Working parent, weekends only
behaviours.how: Works full time; kid outings happen on Saturdays and the odd day off.

behaviours.name: Free-activity loyalist
behaviours.how: Library storytime, parks, the zoo and church groups; rarely pays for kid activities.

behaviours.name: Remote or hybrid worker
behaviours.how: Works from home some days with a toddler around and wants somewhere to get a little done.

behaviours.name: Deal hunter
behaviours.how: Waits for Groupons, free trial days and coupons before trying anything new.

behaviours.name: Moms-group organizer
behaviours.how: Plans playdates and meetups for a group of other parents through Facebook and church.

behaviours.name: Cleanliness and safety first
behaviours.how: Reads every review and checks how clean a place is before letting the kids touch anything.

behaviours.name: Birthday party planner
behaviours.how: Has a birthday coming up and is comparing venues by price, effort and what the kids will remember.
